items.title: Chuck Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 7, 2023
items.q: I’m influenced by him naturally... And Dave and I joked about that

ctx.x: Oh yeah. I’m going to dub in some applause because it’s worth it. You know I know classical people who would really envy that ability and I’m going to stay here for a moment and first of all you said there’s a lot of music in this piano. What does that actually mean for you?

The sound of the instrument, you know like when I got here like I explained before with the Brubeck thing, I did that with this piano and four or five different themes came out immediately. You know? Just letting my hands fall and start to improvise off of the reaction I get from the instrument. And you know that’s developed over a long period of time to have the trust to be able to do that, just to sit down and let my hands fall.
